name: Emulsion break, curing, wash and capsule filter chip
description: Breaks the emulsion, photocures the shells, washes the capsules and removes aggregates. Parametric parts: modules capsule_trap use the nearest library block as a stand-in (real part and sizing in autochip_part / params). Modules listed in missing_parts with a 'module' field are parametric with no library block. build_chip.py builds the stand-ins at library size; the exact chip needs the autochip layout stage.
source: autochip chip plan spc_single_cell_workflow_assayathon_demo (protocol spc_single_cell_workflow, constraints assayathon_demo)

modules.does: A mesh with 25 um pores (under 0.4 x the capsule size) holds the capsules. Emulsion-breaking agent (own line) flushes the oil out, then photoinitiator is flushed in and cured under 405 nm. The same water-based reagent_line carries photoinitiator and then wash buffer, with the syringe swapped between steps.

missing_parts.why: parametric part with no library block; the autochip layout stage draws it

steps_text.12: Add emulsion-breaking agent and remove the oil phase.
steps_text.13: Photocure the capsule shells with 405 nm light in the presence of photoinitiator.
steps_text.14: Wash the capsules in buffer to remove oil and free reagents.
steps_text.15: Filter the capsules through a strainer to remove aggregates.
